interface.name: e6_vc_image

description.summary: VideoCore III global images as wl_buffers

interface.description: A client draws into a VC global image (EGL_BRCM_global_image, created with message 0x4019) and hands its two ids to the compositor, which samples the image as a texture. The pixels stay on the VideoCore. The compositor releases a buffer once a later one is on screen; until then the client must not draw into it.

entry.name: invalid_size
entry.summary: width or height out of range

request.name: create_buffer

description.summary: wrap a global image in a wl_buffer

request.description: format is the 0x4019 format word: low bits 0 ARGB premultiplied, 1 ARGB, 2 XRGB, 3 RGB565, usage bits 0x20 (GLES2 renders) and 0x200 (GLES2 textures) set.
